name: proxmox-ve
label: Proxmox VE Hypervisor
description: Proxmox VE connector, Enables VM and container provisioning, configuration and deletion via the Proxmox REST API using token-based authentication.

fields.name: host
fields.title: Hostname / IP
fields.tooltip: Specify the hostname or IP address of the Proxmox VE server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.
fields.description: Specify the hostname or IP address of the Proxmox VE server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.name: port
fields.title: Port
fields.tooltip: Specify the port of the Proxmox VE API. By default, this is set to 8006.
fields.description: Specify the port of the Proxmox VE API. By default, this is set to 8006.

fields.name: token_id
fields.title: Token ID
fields.tooltip: Specify the token ID used to access the Proxmox VE API, in the format user@authentication_method!TokenID, as displayed in the Proxmox web interface.
fields.description: Specify the token ID used to access the Proxmox VE API, in the format user@authentication_method!TokenID, as displayed in the Proxmox web interface.

fields.name: token_secret
fields.title: Token Secret (Token Secret ID)
fields.tooltip: Specify the token secret that is associated with the token ID, as displayed in the Proxmox web interface.
fields.description: Specify the token secret that is associated with the token ID, as displayed in the Proxmox web interface.

fields.name: node
fields.title: Default Node Name
fields.tooltip: Specify the name of the node, for example pve, to use when a playbook does not provide a node parameter.
fields.description: Specify the name of the node, for example pve, to use when a playbook does not provide a node parameter.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is not selected, i.e., set to false.
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is not selected, i.e., set to false.

operations.title: Get Version
operations.description: Retrieves the version of the Proxmox VE server.

operations.title: Get Cluster HA Status
operations.description: Retrieves the high availability (HA) status of the entire cluster, including its VMs, or of a single VM based on the VMID filter that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: Filter by VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the VM whose HA status you want to retrieve. If you do not specify a VMID, this operation returns the HA status for the entire cluster.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the VMID of the VM whose HA status you want to retrieve. If you do not specify a VMID, this operation returns the HA status for the entire cluster.

operations.title: Get Next VMID
operations.description: Retrieves the next available VMID on the Proxmox VE server.

operations.title: Clone VM
operations.description: Clones a VM from a template based on the node, template VMID, new VMID, name, and storage that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: Template VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the template that you want to clone.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the template that you want to clone.

parameters.name: newid
parameters.title: New VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID to assign to the new VM.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID to assign to the new VM.

parameters.name: name
parameters.title: Name
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name to assign to the new VM.
parameters.description: Specify the name to assign to the new VM.

parameters.name: storage
parameters.title: Storage
parameters.tooltip: Specify the storage on which to create the disk of the new VM.
parameters.description: Specify the storage on which to create the disk of the new VM.

parameters.name: full
parameters.title: Full Clone
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to create a full clone. If you do not select this option, a linked clone is created. By default, this option is selected.
parameters.description: Select this option to create a full clone. If you do not select this option, a linked clone is created. By default, this option is selected.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.title: Clone Wait Timeout (seconds)
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum time, in seconds, to wait for the clone task to complete. By default, this is set to 1800 seconds. Increase this value for large full clones.
parameters.description: Specify the maximum time, in seconds, to wait for the clone task to complete. By default, this is set to 1800 seconds. Increase this value for large full clones.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the template resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the template resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

parameters.name: target_node
parameters.title: Target Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node on which to create the clone, if it differs from the source node.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node on which to create the clone, if it differs from the source node.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.title: Pool Name
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the pool in which you want to create the new VM.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the pool in which you want to create the new VM.

operations.title: Migrate VM
operations.description: Migrates a VM to a different Proxmox node based on the node, target node, and VMID that you have specified.

parameters.name: target_node
parameters.title: Proxmox Target Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node to which you want to migrate the VM.
parameters.description: Specify the name of the Proxmox node to which you want to migrate the VM.

parameters.name: current_node
parameters.title: Proxmox Current Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node on which the VM is currently deployed.
parameters.description: Specify the name of the Proxmox node on which the VM is currently deployed.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the VM that you want to migrate.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the VM that you want to migrate.

parameters.name: online
parameters.title: Online Migration
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to perform the migration online, as a live migration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Select this option to perform the migration online, as a live migration.

parameters.name: with_conntrack_state
parameters.title: With Conntrack State
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to preserve the conntrack state during the migration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Select this option to preserve the conntrack state during the migration.

operations.title: Create Container
operations.description: Creates an LXC container based on the node, VMID, hostname, OS template, and resource settings that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID to assign to the container.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID to assign to the container.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.title: Hostname
parameters.tooltip: Specify the hostname to assign to the container.
parameters.description: Specify the hostname to assign to the container.

parameters.name: ostemplate
parameters.title: OS Template
parameters.tooltip: Specify the OS template from which to create the container, for example local:vztmpl/ubuntu-22.04-standard_22.04-1_amd64.tar.zst.
parameters.description: Specify the OS template from which to create the container, for example local:vztmpl/ubuntu-22.04-standard_22.04-1_amd64.tar.zst.

parameters.name: cores
parameters.title: Cores
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of CPU cores to allocate to the container. By default, this is set to 2.
parameters.description: Specify the number of CPU cores to allocate to the container. By default, this is set to 2.

parameters.name: memory
parameters.title: Memory (MB)
parameters.tooltip: Specify the amount of RAM, in MB, to allocate to the container. By default, this is set to 2048.
parameters.description: Specify the amount of RAM, in MB, to allocate to the container. By default, this is set to 2048.

parameters.name: rootfs
parameters.title: Root FS
parameters.tooltip: Specify the root file system of the container, for example local-lvm:20.
parameters.description: Specify the root file system of the container, for example local-lvm:20.

parameters.name: net0
parameters.title: Network
parameters.tooltip: Specify the configuration of the net0 network interface, for example name=eth0,bridge=vmbr0,ip=.../24,gw=....
parameters.description: Specify the configuration of the net0 network interface, for example name=eth0,bridge=vmbr0,ip=.../24,gw=....

parameters.name: password
parameters.title: Root Password
parameters.tooltip: Specify the root password to set on the container.
parameters.description: Specify the root password to set on the container.

parameters.name: swap
parameters.title: Swap (MB)
parameters.tooltip: Specify the amount of swap space, in MB, to allocate to the container. By default, this is set to 0.
parameters.description: Specify the amount of swap space, in MB, to allocate to the container. By default, this is set to 0.

parameters.name: nameserver
parameters.title: Nameserver
parameters.tooltip: Specify the DNS server to configure on the container, for example 1.1.1.1.
parameters.description: Specify the DNS server to configure on the container, for example 1.1.1.1.

parameters.name: unprivileged
parameters.title: Unprivileged
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to create an unprivileged container. If you do not select this option, a privileged container is created. By default, this option is selected, together with nesting=1.
parameters.description: Select this option to create an unprivileged container. If you do not select this option, a privileged container is created. By default, this option is selected, together with nesting=1.

parameters.name: features
parameters.title: Features
parameters.tooltip: Specify the LXC features to enable on the container, for example nesting=1. Use nesting=1 for console and nesting support.
parameters.description: Specify the LXC features to enable on the container, for example nesting=1. Use nesting=1 for console and nesting support.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which to create the container. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which to create the container. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Configure Container
operations.description: Updates the configuration of an LXC container based on the node, VMID, and body parameters that you have specified. Use this operation after you create a container if the create operation did not apply settings such as features or unprivileged.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the container that you want to configure.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the container that you want to configure.

parameters.name: body_params
parameters.title: Body Parameters
parameters.tooltip: Specify the configuration to apply to the container, in JSON format, for example {"features": "nesting=1", "unprivileged": 0}.
parameters.description: Specify the configuration to apply to the container, in JSON format, for example {"features": "nesting=1", "unprivileged": 0}.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Configure VM
operations.description: Updates the configuration of a VM, such as its cloud-init or networking settings, based on the node, VMID, and body parameters that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.description: VMID of the VM

parameters.name: body_params
parameters.title: Body Parameters
parameters.description: Parameters as JSON object (for example ipconfig0, nameserver, ciuser)

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Resize VM Disk
operations.description: Resizes a disk that is attached to a VM based on the node, VMID, disk ID, and size that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the VM whose disk you want to resize.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the VM whose disk you want to resize.

parameters.name: disk
parameters.title: Disk
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the disk that you want to resize. By default, this is set to scsi0.
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the disk that you want to resize. By default, this is set to scsi0.

parameters.name: target_gb
parameters.title: Target size (GB)
parameters.tooltip: Specify the size, in GB, to which you want to grow the boot disk. This operation is skipped if the disk is already larger than this size.
parameters.description: Specify the size, in GB, to which you want to grow the boot disk. This operation is skipped if the disk is already larger than this size.

parameters.name: assume_current_gb
parameters.title: Assume Current Size (GB)
parameters.tooltip: Specify the size, in GB, to assume as the current disk size when the VM Assume current configuration does not report a readable size, for example the default of size (GB) 10 GB in a template.
parameters.description: Specify the size, in GB, to assume as the current disk size when the VM Assume current configuration does not report a readable size, for example the default of size (GB) 10 GB in a template.

parameters.name: size
parameters.title: Size
parameters.tooltip: Specify an explicit resize value, for example +10G or 32G. This parameter is used only when you do not specify a target size.
parameters.description: Specify an explicit resize value, for example +10G or 32G. This parameter is used only when you do not specify a target size.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.title: Resize Wait Timeout (seconds)
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum time, in seconds, to wait for the resize task to complete. By default, this is set to 600 seconds.
parameters.description: Specify the maximum time, in seconds, to wait for the resize task to complete. By default, this is set to 600 seconds.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Update VM Cloud-Init
operations.description: Regenerates the cloud-init drive of a VM after its configuration has changed, based on the node and VMID that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the VM whose cloud-init drive you want to regenerate.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the VM whose cloud-init drive you want to regenerate.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Start VM
operations.description: Starts a VM based on the node and VMID that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the VM that you want to start.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the VM that you want to start.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Stop VM
operations.description: Stops a VM based on the node and VMID that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the VM that you want to stop.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the VM that you want to stop.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Start Container
operations.description: Starts an LXC container based on the node and VMID that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the container that you want to start.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the container that you want to start.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Stop Container
operations.description: Stops an LXC container based on the node and VMID that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the container that you want to stop.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the container that you want to stop.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Destroy VM
operations.description: Deletes a VM based on the node and VMID that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the VM that you want to delete.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the VM that you want to delete.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration

parameters.name: purge
parameters.title: Purge
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to also delete the unused volumes that belong to the VM. By default, this option is selected.
parameters.description: (Optional) Select this option to also delete the unused volumes that belong to the VM. By default, this option is selected.

parameters.name: destroy-unreferenced-disks
parameters.title: Destroy Unreferenced Disks
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to also delete the unreferenced disks that are owned by the VM. By default, this option is selected.
parameters.description: (Optional) Select this option to also delete the unreferenced disks that are owned by the VM. By default, this option is selected.

operations.title: Destroy Container
operations.description: Deletes an LXC container based on the node and VMID that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the container that you want to delete.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the container that you want to delete.

parameters.name: force
parameters.title: Force
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to forcibly stop a running container before it is destroyed. By default, this option is not selected.
parameters.description: Select this option to forcibly stop a running container before it is destroyed. By default, this option is not selected.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: List VMs
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all VMs on a node, optionally including the configuration of each VM, based on the node that you have specified.

parameters.name: include_config
parameters.title: Include Config
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to also retrieve the configuration, such as the disks and network interfaces, of each VM. Selecting this option results in additional API calls. By default, this option is not selected.
parameters.description: Select this option to also retrieve the configuration, such as the disks and network interfaces, of each VM. Selecting this option results in additional API calls. By default, this option is not selected.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, whose VMs you want to list. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, whose VMs you want to list. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: List Containers
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all LXC containers on a node, optionally including the configuration of each container, based on the node that you have specified.

parameters.name: include_config
parameters.title: Include Config
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to also retrieve the configuration, such as the disks and network interfaces, of each container. Selecting this option results in additional API calls.
parameters.description: Select this option to also retrieve the configuration, such as the disks and network interfaces, of each container. Selecting this option results in additional API calls.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, whose containers you want to list. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, whose containers you want to list. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Get VM Config
operations.description: Retrieves the configuration of a VM, including its disks and network interfaces, based on the node and VMID that you have specified. Use this operation for inventory synchronization.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the VM whose configuration you want to retrieve.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the VM whose configuration you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Get Container Config
operations.description: Retrieves the configuration of an LXC container, including its root file system, mount points, and network interfaces, based on the node and VMID that you have specified. Use this operation for inventory synchronization.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the container whose configuration you want to retrieve.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the container whose configuration you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Get Task Status
operations.description: Retrieves the status of an asynchronous task, such as a clone job, based on the node and UPID that you have specified.

parameters.name: upid
parameters.title: UPID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the UPID of the task whose status you want to retrieve, for example UPID:pve:00001234:....
parameters.description: Specify the UPID of the task whose status you want to retrieve, for example UPID:pve:00001234:....

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the task is running. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the task is running. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Get Nodes
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all nodes in the cluster, along with their online or offline status.

operations.title: Get Cluster Resources
operations.description: Retrieves the resources that are available in the cluster based on the type filter that you have specified.

parameters.name: type
parameters.title: Type Filter
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the type of resource by which you want to filter the results: node, vm, or storage. If you do not specify a type, this operation returns all resources.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the type of resource by which you want to filter the results: node, vm, or storage. If you do not specify a type, this operation returns all resources.

operations.title: Get VM Status
operations.description: Retrieves the detailed status of a VM, including whether it is running or stopped, based on the node and VMID that you have specified. This operation requires the VM.Audit privilege on the VM.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the VM whose status you want to retrieve.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the VM whose status you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the VM resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Get Container Status
operations.description: Retrieves the detailed status of an LXC container, including whether it is running or stopped, based on the node and VMID that you have specified. This operation requires the VM.Audit privilege.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VMID of the container whose status you want to retrieve.
parameters.description: Specify the VMID of the container whose status you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the container resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Get Node Status
operations.description: Retrieves the resource usage of a node, including its memory and CPU, based on the node that you have specified. This operation requires the Sys.Audit privilege.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, whose status you want to retrieve. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, whose status you want to retrieve. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Get Storage Status
operations.description: Retrieves the status of a storage, including its total, used, and available disk space, based on the node and storage ID that you have specified. This operation requires the Datastore.Audit privilege.

parameters.name: storage
parameters.title: Storage ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the storage whose status you want to retrieve, for example local.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the storage whose status you want to retrieve, for example local.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the storage resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the storage resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Get Storage Content
operations.description: Retrieves the content of a storage, such as its templates and images, based on the node, storage ID, and content filter that you have specified. This operation requires the Datastore.Audit privilege.

parameters.name: storage
parameters.title: Storage ID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the storage whose content you want to retrieve, for example local.
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the storage whose content you want to retrieve, for example local.

parameters.name: content
parameters.title: Content Filter
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of content types by which you want to filter the results, for example vztmpl, iso, or images.
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of content types by which you want to filter the results, for example vztmpl, iso, or images.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the storage resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the name of the Proxmox node, for example pve, on which the storage resides. If you do not specify a node, the connector uses the default node name from its configuration.

operations.title: Disable VM HA
operations.description: Removes a VM from the high availability (HA) configuration, so that it operates as a standalone VM, based on the VMID that you have specified.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.title: VMID
parameters.tooltip:
Specify the VMID of the VM that you want to remove from the HA
configuration.
parameters.description:
Specify the VMID of the VM that you want to remove from the HA
configuration.

operations.title: API Request (Generic)
operations.description: Sends a request to any Proxmox VE API endpoint based on the method, endpoint, request headers, and body that you have specified.

parameters.name: method
parameters.title: Method
parameters.tooltip: Select the HTTP method to use for the request. You can choose from the following options: GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE.
parameters.description: Select the HTTP method to use for the request. You can choose from the following options: GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Specify the path of the API endpoint, after /api2/json/ and without a leading slash.
parameters.description: Specify the path of the API endpoint, after /api2/json/ and without a leading slash.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.title: Request Headers
parameters.tooltip: Specify any additional headers to send with the request.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify any additional headers to send with the request.

parameters.name: body
parameters.title: Body (JSON)
parameters.tooltip: Specify the body of the request, in JSON format. This parameter is used for both JSON payloads and form-encoded payloads.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the body of the request, in JSON format. This parameter is used for both JSON payloads and form-encoded payloads.
